critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3934 lines — should be split into modules (telegram_bot.py, tools.py, admin.py, payments.py) for maintainability. Not blocking but accumulating tech debt.

_handle_phishing_analyse imports emergentintegrations.llm.chat inside the function (line ~894). Same pattern in _handle_ai_chat. Move to top-of-module import (or a single helper) to avoid repeated import overhead per request.
AI quota is incremented BEFORE the LLM call (_tg_ai_bump on line 1133); if the LLM fails the user still loses a question. Consider bumping only on successful reply.

_handle_spin computes new_bal = float(user.get('balance') or 0) + amount from the pre-increment cached read; safer to re-read users.find_one after $inc to display the actual persisted balance (race-safe).
DeprecationWarning on @app.on_event(startup/shutdown) — FastAPI lifespan handlers preferred (cosmetic).
/refer: referral_code is derived from user_id[:8].upper(); for user_ids that aren't hex this could collide. Consider uuid4().hex[:8] or a short b62 hash.
test_credentials: Admin password 'admin123' (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) used for /api/admin/* regression. Bot token + webhook secret were NOT needed — _get_bot_token + _tg_call are monkey-patched in-process per the iteration_3 pattern recommended by the main agent.
seed_data_creation: Per-test setup creates TEST_-prefixed users with telegram_chat_id in {99999, 88888, 77777} and a TEST_ announcement for /news. cleanup_data fixture wipes db.tg_state, db.tg_ai_quota, db.users (by chat_id), db.spin_history (TEST_), db.wallet_transactions (TEST_) before AND after every test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_tg_bot_upgrade.py — runs end-to-end in 23s. Pattern: install single asyncio loop BEFORE `import server` so motor.AsyncIOMotorClient binds to the same loop the tests use (otherwise you get 'attached to a different loop' RuntimeError). Stub server._tg_call → returns {ok:True}, server._get_bot_token → returns 'TEST_BOT_TOKEN'. For AI tests, monkey-patch emergentintegrations.llm.chat.LlmChat with a FakeChat that exposes with_model() and async send_message(). HTTP regression tests hit the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. All new TG bot flows behave per spec — state machine advances correctly through odds/quote/phishing/breach multi-step flows and clears at the end; spin is idempotent per UTC day; AI quota hard-caps at 10/day per chat_id; unlinked-user nudges work for /wallet /spin /refer.
